title: $2M Sale
blurb: A UK collector sold Pokémon cards for over $2 million, reportedly a UK record.
quip: Some binders are worth more than houses.

title: Set Alert
blurb: The Deck Crafter's Collection is out now, packed with competitive staples, and Lorcana heads to Disney Cruise Line ships in 2027.
quip: New staples. Same old shuffle face.

title: Deck Crafter's
blurb: The Deck Crafter's Collection is out now, and Lorcana heads to Disney Cruise Line ships in 2027.
quip: Staples in the box. Sea legs in 2027.

title: Mihawk Banned
blurb: OP14-020 Dracule Mihawk is banned, alternate arts included, and now in effect.
source: Official One Piece Card Game site
quip: Sheathe the swords. Rebuild the deck.

title: Doug's Collection
blurb: Items from Doug Ferguson's Pokémon collection go to auction on November 3.
quip: Somebody's grail is about to change addresses.

title: Chorus of Steel
blurb: Smash Palace arrives October 30, bringing back Ultimate Pit Fight with two new heroes.
quip: Bring a friend. Then flatten them, lovingly.

title: Into the Inkdark
blurb: Preorders are open, with release expected February 12, 2027 and the first serialized Illustrious cards.
quip: Ink now, brag in February.

title: Fracture Delayed
blurb: The Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed by shipping and production issues, after the Star Trek Commander Decks slipped first.
quip: Good things come to those who refresh the tracking page.

title: Dual Fusion
blurb: Dual Fusion is out in Pokémon TCG Pocket, debuting dual-type cards led by Mega Mewtwo X ex and Mega Greninja ex.
quip: Two types, one pack, zero chill.

title: Superdrop
blurb: Set Phasers to Superdrop brings five Star Trek Secret Lair drops, with preorders opening November 9.
quip: Beam up your wallet.

title: $4.88M Mudkip
blurb: Goldin's Pokémon 30th Anniversary auction passed $28 million, led by a PSA 10 Art Academy Mudkip promo at $4.88 million.
quip: Mudkip just outbid your rent.

title: Release Radar
blurb: A packed release radar: Magic's Star Trek set on Nov 13, One Piece Heroines Edition Vol. 2 and OP-18, and more dates for your wallet.
quip: Save this. Your wallet already did.

title: Star Trek Timeline
blurb: The complete Magic x Star Trek timeline, with every date you need for the release.
quip: Boldly going where your budget hasn't.

title: $600M Quarter
blurb: Magic crossed $600 million in one quarter for Hasbro, while the Reality Fracture Secret Lair bundle slipped past Oct 23.
quip: Big numbers, late bundles.

title: Launch Day
blurb: Riftbound's 5th set Radiance, with 9 new Legends, and Lorcana's Hyperia City (feat. Coco) both drop this Friday.
quip: So many shiny new cards. So few dollars.

title: Banlist Shock
blurb: After YCS Houston, Konami's new list hits 34 Forbidden and 8 Limited, with Called by the Grave leading the charge.
quip: Deckboxes were opened. Tears were shed.

title: Delta Reign
blurb: Delta Reign is headlined by Mega Rayquaza EX, with prereleases from Oct 24 and full release on Nov 6.
quip: Zia held the desk solo. Rayquaza held the spotlight.

title: 2.8 Billion Cards
blurb: Disney Lorcana marks 3 years and 2.8 billion cards sold with a Beauty and the Beast collection, plus Mega Mewtwo X EX in TCG Pocket.
quip: Tale as old as time, print run as big as ever.

title: Robin Manga Rare
blurb: One Piece OP-18 brings Nico Robin's first Manga Rare and Yoshitaka Amano Secret Rares, plus Star Wars: Unlimited HomeWorld and Pokémon's ex Star tease.
quip: Art collectors, hide your wallets.

title: Face Scan Check-in
blurb: Bandai says face recognition check-in is coming to the TCG Plus app, plus Fusion World's Brightness of Hope and Union Arena's Arknights drop.
quip: Smile, you're registered for the tournament.

title: Maze of Machines
blurb: Konami's 153-card Maze of Machines booster set releases March 19, 2027, with Rampant Barrel Dragon and 10 new GX cards.
quip: Barrel Dragon called. It wants its six-shooter back.

title: Mega Rayquaza ex
blurb: The Mega Rayquaza ex Premium Tournament Collection releases February 12, 2027, with four foil promos and eight booster packs.
quip: Rayquaza finally has somewhere to sit between rounds.

title: Gundam at PAX
blurb: The Gundam Card Game heads to PAX Unplugged in Philadelphia, December 4-6, 2026, with demo decks and sealed battles.
quip: Mobile suits, meet folding tables.

title: Valentine's Box
blurb: The Pokémon Company's Valentine's Box hits retail January 15, 2027, with 20 booster packs, To/From labels and a mailbox.
quip: Roses are red, packs are sealed.

title: Wager Rules Fix
blurb: Flesh and Blood's October 30 rules update moves Wager to the damage step, restoring Zane's combo, and errata's Trained Saurian.
quip: Place your bets... a little earlier now.

title: Worlds in Paris
blurb: Flesh and Blood's World Championship hits Paris November 5-8 with more than $300,000 in cash prizes, live on YouTube from Friday.
quip: Pack a sleeve. And a beret.

title: Star Trek prerelease
blurb: Magic's Star Trek prerelease starts November 6, with six Play Boosters, a foil promo, a deck box and a spindown die in each pack.
quip: Engage the sealed deck, Number One.

title: Delta Reign Friday
blurb: Pokémon's Mega Evolution: Delta Reign hits stores November 6, bringing Mega Rayquaza back for the first time in over a decade.
quip: Rayquaza took a decade-long lunch break.

title: Star Trek on Arena
blurb: Magic's Star Trek set launches on MTG Arena November 10, with an early access event streaming Wednesday on YouTube and Twitch.
quip: Boldly going where your free time went.

title: Pokémon Happy Meals
blurb: Pokémon Happy Meals return to participating US McDonald's restaurants November 10, with 15 mini toys and 15 collectible cards.
quip: Finally, a booster pack that comes with fries.

title: Lorcana D23 Winners
blurb: Winners of the online draw for Lorcana's 2026 D23 Collection and Hunny Wizard playmat get emails from November 4, with orders arriving within two to three weeks.
quip: For once, the inbox might beat the booster pack.

title: Lorcana Book Ban
blurb: Disney Lorcana banned My Adventure Book from Core Constructed, in effect since November 3, saying it gave decks with few or no characters too much consistency.
quip: This book just got checked out for good.

title: SWU Gift Box
blurb: Fantasy Flight's Star Wars: Unlimited Gift Box hits retail November 20, with 8 boosters and 3 exclusive promos: Moff Gideon, General Veers and Icons 2027 Chewbacca.
quip: Moff Gideon, now gift-wrapped.

title: The Reckoning
blurb: Riftbound's 250-card set The Reckoning hit preorder, with over 60 Showcase cards, reaching retail April 30, 2027.
quip: April's a long wait. Stretch first.

title: One Lotus dated
blurb: Flesh and Blood's Paris keynote lists One Lotus for Q2 2027 and Ancients Awaken for Q3, premiering in May and September.
quip: Two new sets. Your wallet heard that.

title: Hall of Fame
blurb: The Pokémon Trading Card Game joined the National Toy Hall of Fame's class of 2026, alongside Bingo, Care Bears and the playground slide.
quip: Your binder is basically a museum piece now.

title: T1 Bundle Draw
blurb: Riftbound's T1 2025 Worlds Champion Player Bundle, with Champion cards picked by Faker and team, goes to an online drawing opening November 13.
quip: Faker picked the cards. You just have to pick the drawing.

title: Gundam 3-on-3
blurb: The Gundam Card Game's "Claim Miorine" 3-on-3 team battles hit participating stores December 4, with a foil promo for the winning team.
quip: Finally, a reason to make two friends.

title: Star Trek signatures
blurb: Magic's Star Trek set lands November 13, and Collector Boosters can hold cards hand-signed by Star Trek actors.
quip: Live long and pull an autograph.

title: Mega Greninja ex
blurb: Pokémon's ready-to-play 60-card Mega Greninja ex League Battle Deck, with Mega Starmie ex, lands this week.
quip: Sixty cards, zero excuses for a bad build.

title: Maestros Friday
blurb: Yu-Gi-Oh!'s 125-card Magnificent Maestros lands November 13, with Grand Master Rares serial-numbered to 100.
quip: One hundred copies. Please stop checking your binder.

title: Fang wins Worlds
blurb: Nicolas Jamoulle won Flesh and Blood's World Championship in Paris on Fang, and the runner-up played Fang too.
quip: Paris had one dragon on top, and another right behind it.

title: Polygon Secret Lair
blurb: Magic's Rise of the Polygons Secret Lair gives Balefire Dragon retro video game art, on sale November 16-30 with half the sale price going to Extra Life.
quip: Low poly, high charity, maximum dragon.

title: Burger King Magic
blurb: Magic teamed up with Burger King Italy: a meal with a burger-box style deck box and 100 sleeves, November 10-30.
quip: Have it your way: extra sleeves, hold the pickles.

title: $200K Pro Tours
blurb: Flesh and Blood's 2027 World Tour brings three $200,000 Pro Tours, one Global Leaderboard and a $10,000 Player of the Year.
quip: Three Pro Tours, zero excuses to skip practice.

title: MLP: Coronation
blurb: Kayou's fifth English My Little Pony TCG set, The Coronation, reaches retail February 19, 2027, with three new mechanics.
quip: Friendship is magic. Pulling the chase card is luck.

title: Star Trek: League
blurb: Magic's Star Trek set is out today, and the To Boldly Go sealed league runs in stores through January 28, 2027.
quip: Six boosters, four quadrants, one promotion to Captain. Engage.

title: Pikachu Day box
blurb: The Pokémon Day 2027 Collection lands January 29 with a stamped foil Pikachu promo, three booster packs and a coin.
quip: Pikachu's birthday party comes with its own party favors.
